cues.text: You should have done it back at the hotel.
cues.en: You should have done it back at the hotel.
cues.zh: 你應該回到酒店就做。

cues.text: Now, here comes the trickiest part of all !
cues.en: Now, here comes the trickiest part of all !
cues.zh: 現在，最棘手的部分來了！

cues.text: How do you know where and when your ship will arrive ?
cues.en: How do you know where and when your ship will arrive ?
cues.zh: 您如何知道您的船將在何時何地到達？

cues.text: Because it's all a bit chaotic : You don't have big signs like you have at an airport.
cues.en: Because it's all a bit chaotic : You don't have big signs like you have at an airport.
cues.zh: 因為這裡有點混亂：沒有像機場那樣的大標誌。

cues.text: There's rarely any building at all.
cues.en: There's rarely any building at all.
cues.zh: 很少有任何建築物。

cues.text: It's just a large open area with lots of people waiting left and right.
cues.en: It's just a large open area with lots of people waiting left and right.
cues.zh: 這只是一個很大的空地，左右都有很多人在等待。

cues.text: So ... What Greeks always do is : When you get to the port, you will already see a few lines of people
cues.en: So ... What Greeks always do is : When you get to the port, you will already see a few lines of people
cues.zh: 所以......希臘人總是做的是：當你到達港口時，你已經看到了幾條人龍

cues.text: clearly waiting for something specific.
cues.en: clearly waiting for something specific.
cues.zh: 顯然是在等待特定的東西。

cues.text: Go up to those people and ask where they're headed ...
cues.en: Go up to those people and ask where they're headed ...
cues.zh: 走到那些人身邊，問他們要去哪裡…

cues.text: until you find your people.
cues.en: until you find your people.
cues.zh: 直到找到你的人。

cues.text: And then, every time a ferry arrives, check the company and the ship name written on it
cues.en: And then, every time a ferry arrives, check the company and the ship name written on it
cues.zh: 然後，每次渡輪到達時，檢查上面寫的公司和船名

cues.text: and see if it's yours.
cues.en: and see if it's yours.
cues.zh: 看看是不是你的。

cues.text: This one, for instance, is a Seajets and the ship's name is "Worldchampion jet".
cues.en: This one, for instance, is a Seajets and the ship's name is "Worldchampion jet".
cues.zh: 例如，這艘是 Seajets，該船的名稱是“Worldchampion jet”。

cues.text: Your ship's name will be written on your ticket and there's only one ship with each name.
cues.en: Your ship's name will be written on your ticket and there's only one ship with each name.
cues.zh: 您的船名將寫在您的機票上，並且每個名稱只有一艘船。

cues.text: So, when you see it ... it's yours, guaranteed.
cues.en: So, when you see it ... it's yours, guaranteed.
cues.zh: 所以，當您看到它時...它就是您的，保證。

cues.text: Now, when exactly will your ship arrive ?
cues.en: Now, when exactly will your ship arrive ?
cues.zh: 現在，你的船到底什麼時候到達？

cues.text: Well, usually around 15 minutes before official departure time
cues.en: Well, usually around 15 minutes before official departure time
cues.zh: 嗯，通常是在正式出發時間前 15 分鐘左右

cues.text: since that's the time they need to disembark everyone and then load up again.
cues.en: since that's the time they need to disembark everyone and then load up again.
cues.zh: 因為那是他們需要讓所有人下船然後再次上車的時間。

cues.text: But don't be surprised : small delays of like 10-20 minutes are common
cues.en: But don't be surprised : small delays of like 10-20 minutes are common
cues.zh: 但請不要感到驚訝：10-20 分鐘左右的小延遲很常見

cues.text: and, during peak season, you can sometimes have bigger delays, as well.
cues.en: and, during peak season, you can sometimes have bigger delays, as well.
cues.zh: 而且，在旺季期間，有時也會出現更大的延誤。

cues.text: Alright ! Now, let's talk about the actual boarding.
cues.en: Alright ! Now, let's talk about the actual boarding.
cues.zh: 好吧 ！現在，我們來談談實際登機的情況。

cues.text: How does it go exactly ?
cues.en: How does it go exactly ?
cues.zh: 具體進展如何？

cues.text: A few weeks ago, I asked you on Instagram how you would describe your experience of boarding a Greek ferry.
cues.en: A few weeks ago, I asked you on Instagram how you would describe your experience of boarding a Greek ferry.
cues.zh: 幾週前，我在 Instagram 上問你如何描述登上希臘渡輪的經歷。

cues.text: And the word that came back in nearly every answer was "CHAOS" !
cues.en: And the word that came back in nearly every answer was "CHAOS" !
cues.zh: 幾乎每個答案中出現的單字都是「混亂」！

cues.text: And yes ! It's true ! It is pretty intense !
cues.en: And yes ! It's true ! It is pretty intense !
cues.zh: 是的！這是真的！相當激烈！

cues.text: First, you have everyone disembarking from the ship, together with the cars, which are trying not to run over anyone ...
cues.en: First, you have everyone disembarking from the ship, together with the cars, which are trying not to run over anyone ...
cues.zh: 首先，你讓每個人都從船上下來，還有汽車，盡量不要撞到任何人...

cues.text: And then, the boarding starts.
cues.en: And then, the boarding starts.
cues.zh: 然後，登機開始。

cues.text: There's no real line : everyone is trying to squeeze in.
cues.en: There's no real line : everyone is trying to squeeze in.
cues.zh: 沒有真正的界線：每個人都在努力擠進去。

cues.text: So yeah ! Don't expect something nice and tidy !
cues.en: So yeah ! Don't expect something nice and tidy !
cues.zh: 所以是的！不要期望有漂亮整潔的東西！

cues.text: This is Greece : We do it the chaotic way ...
cues.en: This is Greece : We do it the chaotic way ...
cues.zh: 這就是希臘：我們以混亂的方式做事......

cues.text: Now, regarding your luggage. How does it work ?
cues.en: Now, regarding your luggage. How does it work ?
cues.zh: 現在，關於您的行李。它是如何運作的？

cues.text: Well, you can take all your bags with you upstairs, if you want.
cues.en: Well, you can take all your bags with you upstairs, if you want.
cues.zh: 好吧，如果你願意的話，你可以把所有的行李帶到樓上。

cues.text: But, if you intend on moving around the ship throughout the voyage,
cues.en: But, if you intend on moving around the ship throughout the voyage,
cues.zh: 但是，如果您打算在整個航程中在船上移動，

cues.text: your bags will probably become a bit of a nuisance.
cues.en: your bags will probably become a bit of a nuisance.
cues.zh: 你的包包可能會變得有點麻煩。

cues.text: So, if you want, you can leave your bags.
cues.en: So, if you want, you can leave your bags.
cues.zh: 因此，如果您願意，可以寄放行李。

cues.text: There are always some racks just there, as you enter the ship.
cues.en: There are always some racks just there, as you enter the ship.
cues.zh: 當你進入船時，那裡總是有一些架子。

cues.text: They're free to use.
cues.en: They're free to use.
cues.zh: 它們可以免費使用。

cues.text: Now how safe is it ? Well, pretty safe.
cues.en: Now how safe is it ? Well, pretty safe.
cues.zh: 現在安全嗎？嗯，很安全。

cues.text: I've never heard anyone getting stuff stolen.
cues.en: I've never heard anyone getting stuff stolen.
cues.zh: 我從來沒聽過有人偷東西。

cues.text: But, still, don't leave any valuables in those bags.
cues.en: But, still, don't leave any valuables in those bags.
cues.zh: 但是，仍然不要在這些包包裡留下任何貴重物品。

cues.text: Take a separate backpack with you, upstairs, with all your valuables.
cues.en: Take a separate backpack with you, upstairs, with all your valuables.
cues.zh: 上樓時請攜帶一個單獨的揹包，並裝上所有貴重物品。

cues.text: So, congratulations ! You're now on board the ferry.
cues.en: So, congratulations ! You're now on board the ferry.
cues.zh: 那麼，恭喜你！您現在已經登上渡輪了。

cues.text: What is there to do during the trip ?
cues.en: What is there to do during the trip ?
cues.zh: 旅途中可以做什麼？

cues.text: Well, if you're on a fast ferry ... Not much ...
cues.en: Well, if you're on a fast ferry ... Not much ...
cues.zh: 好吧，如果你搭乘快速渡輪......不多......

cues.text: You just go and sit down and wait for time to pass.
cues.en: You just go and sit down and wait for time to pass.
cues.zh: 你只需去坐下來等待時間過去。

cues.text: The only thing there is, apart from seats, is a little snack bar,
cues.en: The only thing there is, apart from seats, is a little snack bar,
cues.zh: 唯一的除了座位就是一個小小吃店，

cues.text: in case you get hungry or thirsty.
cues.en: in case you get hungry or thirsty.
cues.zh: 以防你餓了或渴了。

cues.text: If you're on a slow ferry, however, then you've got way more options.
cues.en: If you're on a slow ferry, however, then you've got way more options.
cues.zh: 然而，如果您乘坐慢速渡輪，那麼您就有更多選擇。

cues.text: First of all, you'll have to decide whether you want to sit inside or outside.
cues.en: First of all, you'll have to decide whether you want to sit inside or outside.
cues.zh: 首先，您必須決定要坐在室內還是室外。

cues.text: Outside is, of course, more fun.
cues.en: Outside is, of course, more fun.
cues.zh: 當然，外面更有趣。

cues.text: But it can get pretty windy or very hot.
cues.en: But it can get pretty windy or very hot.
cues.zh: 但天氣可能會變得很大風或很熱。

cues.text: And, in that case, you probably want to go sit inside.
cues.en: And, in that case, you probably want to go sit inside.
cues.zh: 而且，在這種情況下，您可能會想坐在裡面。

cues.text: And just for you know : Many ferries turn on the AC way too hard ... And it gets super cold inside !
cues.en: And just for you know : Many ferries turn on the AC way too hard ... And it gets super cold inside !
cues.zh: 而且您知道：許多渡輪將空調開啟得太厲害......而且裡面會變得非常冷！

cues.text: So, little pro tip : Bring a sweater with you ... Even if it's super hot outside, you might need it !
cues.en: So, little pro tip : Bring a sweater with you ... Even if it's super hot outside, you might need it !
cues.zh: 所以，小專業提示：帶一件毛衣......即使外面超級熱，你可能也需要它！

cues.text: Food on board is decent but, you know, nothing crazy and it's a little overpriced.
cues.en: Food on board is decent but, you know, nothing crazy and it's a little overpriced.
cues.zh: 船上的食物很不錯，但是，你知道，沒什麼瘋狂的，而且價格有點高。

cues.text: That's why Greeks usually grab some savory pies, from a bakery,
cues.en: That's why Greeks usually grab some savory pies, from a bakery,
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼希臘人通常會從麵包店買一些美味的餡餅，

cues.text: on their way to the port and eat that on the way.
cues.en: on their way to the port and eat that on the way.
cues.zh: 在去港口的路上，在路上吃掉它。

cues.text: But if you don't want to go through the trouble of doing that, no worries : food onboard is fine.
cues.en: But if you don't want to go through the trouble of doing that, no worries : food onboard is fine.
cues.zh: 但如果您不想經歷這樣做的麻煩，也不必擔心：船上的食物很好。

cues.text: And, of course, the main attraction, on slow ferries, is to go and stand outside, at the back of the ship,
cues.en: And, of course, the main attraction, on slow ferries, is to go and stand outside, at the back of the ship,
cues.zh: 當然，在緩慢的渡輪上，最吸引人的地方就是站在船尾的外面，

cues.text: when docking at other islands, on the way.
cues.en: when docking at other islands, on the way.
cues.zh: 途中停靠其他島嶼時。

cues.text: And get a glimpse at all these cute white washed houses
cues.en: And get a glimpse at all these cute white washed houses
cues.zh: 看看這些可愛的白色房屋

cues.text: on islands like Paros or Naxos, for instance. Beautiful sights.
cues.en: on islands like Paros or Naxos, for instance. Beautiful sights.
cues.zh: 例如，在帕羅斯島或納克索斯島等島嶼上。美麗的景點。

cues.text: Oh ... and one more thing ...
cues.en: Oh ... and one more thing ...
cues.zh: 哦...還有一件事...

cues.text: When you're at sea, it's common to lose reception, both phone and internet.
cues.en: When you're at sea, it's common to lose reception, both phone and internet.
cues.zh: 當您在海上時，電話和網路訊號中斷是很常見的。

cues.text: So, if you have an important email to send, do it before the ship departs.
cues.en: So, if you have an important email to send, do it before the ship departs.
cues.zh: 因此，如果您有一封重要的電子郵件要傳送，請在船出發前傳送。

cues.text: Alright !
cues.en: Alright !
cues.zh: 好吧 ！

cues.text: Now, how do you know when you're about to arrive at your destination ?
cues.en: Now, how do you know when you're about to arrive at your destination ?
cues.zh: 現在，您如何知道何時即將到達目的地？

cues.text: Well, there's going to be an announcement in Greek, first and then in English,
cues.en: Well, there's going to be an announcement in Greek, first and then in English,
cues.zh: 嗯，首先會用希臘文釋出公告，然後用英文發布，

cues.text: 15 minutes before arriving and then 10 minutes and then 5 minutes.
cues.en: 15 minutes before arriving and then 10 minutes and then 5 minutes.
cues.zh: 到達前 15 分鐘，然後 10 分鐘，然後 5 分鐘。

cues.text: So, you'll have plenty of time to see it coming.
cues.en: So, you'll have plenty of time to see it coming.
cues.zh: 因此，您將有足夠的時間見證它的到來。

cues.text: When you hear the second or third announcement,
cues.en: When you hear the second or third announcement,
cues.zh: 當你聽到第二或第三個通知時，

cues.text: that means it's time to go downstairs, to the vehicle level,
cues.en: that means it's time to go downstairs, to the vehicle level,
cues.zh: 這意味著是時候下樓到車輛樓層了

cues.text: take your bags off the racks and, then, wait there for the ramp to go down.
cues.en: take your bags off the racks and, then, wait there for the ramp to go down.
cues.zh: 把你的行李從架子上拿下來，然後在那裡等待坡道下降。

cues.text: If you're specifically going to Santorini by ferry, you have some amazing views 20 to 25 minutes before arriving.
cues.en: If you're specifically going to Santorini by ferry, you have some amazing views 20 to 25 minutes before arriving.
cues.zh: 如果您專門搭乘渡輪前往聖托里尼，您可以在抵達前 20 至 25 分鐘欣賞到令人驚嘆的景色。

cues.text: Because you first pass by Oia, which looks absolutely epic from sea level.
cues.en: Because you first pass by Oia, which looks absolutely epic from sea level.
cues.zh: 因為您首先會經過伊亞，從海平面上看，這裡絕對是史詩般的。

cues.text: And, then, you'll have the Cliffs of Imerovigli, which are also super impressive !
cues.en: And, then, you'll have the Cliffs of Imerovigli, which are also super impressive !
cues.zh: 然後，您將看到伊莫洛維裡懸崖，這也令人印象深刻！

cues.text: So, yeah, if you're going to Santorini, don't rush down as soon as you hear the first announcement.
cues.en: So, yeah, if you're going to Santorini, don't rush down as soon as you hear the first announcement.
cues.zh: 所以，是的，如果您要去聖托里尼島，請不要在聽到第一個訊息後就急著去。

cues.text: Stay up for a few more minutes to take in all of the views !
cues.en: Stay up for a few more minutes to take in all of the views !
cues.zh: 再熬夜幾分鐘，欣賞所有美景！

cues.text: Alright ! Now, super important : There are a few new rules regarding the Acropolis tickets !
cues.en: Alright ! Now, super important : There are a few new rules regarding the Acropolis tickets !
cues.zh: 好吧 ！現在，非常重要：關於雅典衛城門票有一些新規則！

cues.text: So, if you plan on visiting the Acropolis in Athens, definitely check this video out. Super important !
cues.en: So, if you plan on visiting the Acropolis in Athens, definitely check this video out. Super important !
cues.zh: 因此，如果您計劃參觀雅典衛城，請務必觀看此影片。超重要！

cues.text: And for the awesome e-bike tour, around Athens, it's this one.
cues.en: And for the awesome e-bike tour, around Athens, it's this one.
cues.zh: 對於雅典周圍的精彩電動腳踏車之旅來說，就是這個。

cues.text: And there you go ! That's it for today ! Hope you liked it ! See you in the next one ! Bye !
cues.en: And there you go ! That's it for today ! Hope you liked it ! See you in the next one ! Bye !
cues.zh: 就這樣吧！今天就這樣！希望你喜歡它！下一篇見！再見 ！
